time_basis.sampled_at: wall-clock ISO time of the sample (this app)
time_basis.taken_at: wall-clock ISO time this app took the held image
time_basis.monotonic_ms: the overlay performance.now() at the sample
time_basis.presentation_ms: the overlay performance time at which the held image's newest frame was presented; null before the first frame callback
time_basis.frame_age_ms: measured at the sample as performance.now() minus the held image's newest frame's presentation time, then rounded. monotonic_ms and presentation_ms are rounded separately and read at slightly different moments, so frame_age_ms can differ from their difference by a millisecond or more. null when presentation_ms is null. The capture latency before presentation is not measured.
time_basis.gap_ms: how late the sampler ran for a sample in state 'gap', as measured then; nothing is known about the display during it
